axis_logic.level_delta: mean P19 HYBRID-HAND minus mean P17 HYBRID-HAND within the same metadata level
axis_logic.coherent_axis: all evaluable level deltas are strictly nonzero and have the same sign as the aggregate cohort difference
axis_logic.era_early_late: arithmetic mean of E1/E2 level deltas versus arithmetic mean of E3/E4 level deltas

verdict_hierarchy: SUPPORT_LIMITED if either cohort lacks exactly 48 solve rows or any required axis level is absent
If cohort-difference 90% interval excludes zero: HETEROGENEITY_LOCALIZED iff exactly one axis is coherent; otherwise EFFECT_SIZE_NONSTATIONARY
If cohort-difference 90% interval includes zero: STABLE_COMPLEMENTARITY_SURFACE iff zero axes are coherent; otherwise STABLE_DIRECTION_VARIABLE_MAGNITUDE
